blurb:
Escape the Theme Parks - Embrace Adventure!

Pedal (with electric assist!) through the breathtaking lakefronts of Kissimmee and St. Cloud on a state-of-the-art electric bike. This 4-hour self-guided tour lets you set your own pace, soaking in serene lakes, lush trails, and Florida's vibrant wildlife - from herons to alligators. With a fully paved, extra-wide trail, it's perfect for all skill levels, whether you're a solo explorer or with family.

Why Choose This Tour?
- Effortless Exploration: e-Bikes with pedal assist make riding a breeze!
- Flexible & Self-Guided: Stop for photos, snacks, or wildlife spotting whenever you want.
- Nature at Its Best: Spot birds, turtles, and maybe even an alligator along East Lake Tohopekaliga.
- Safe & Accessible: Wide, paved trails and e-bikes suitable for experienced riders 8+.
- 4 relaxing hours: Plenty of time to linger at the park or to explore downtown.

Discover Central Florida's Hidden Gem on an e-Bike Adventure!

Book your adventure today!
